title: Area Classification
description: Based on real DLD transactions, areas are classified as mature / growth / future / supply pressure. Tags are assigned relative to citywide percentiles — expand to see the rationale.

reason.insufficientSample: Too few comparable sales in this area to classify it.
reason.volActiveTop: Active market ({{n}} sales — top third citywide)
reason.growTop: Prices up {{pct}}% year on year (top third citywide)
reason.volHighGrowNeg: High volume ({{n}} sales) but prices {{pct}}% year on year (softening)
reason.volHighGrowNegNote: Falling prices on high volume usually means ample supply and room to negotiate
reason.volActiveLiquid: Active and liquid ({{n}} sales — top third citywide)
reason.growModerate: Moderate price growth ({{pct}}%) — a settled market
reason.volLowBottom: Lower volume ({{n}} sales — bottom third citywide)
reason.earlyStageNote: Early-stage area: fewer data points, higher uncertainty
reason.volGrowMedian: Both volume and price growth sit mid-range ({{n}} sales, {{pct}}%)

invest.growth: Strong price momentum — worth a look for growth-oriented investors, though check whether it has already run up too far.
invest.supply_pressure: Higher risk from an investment angle (falling prices on high volume); but there is real room to negotiate, so it can suit bargain hunters.
invest.mature: Liquid and low-volatility — suits steady rental-income investors.
invest.future: High risk, high potential — a bet on the area delivering; needs a long hold.
invest.stable: Steady trend; expect neutral investment returns.
invest.insufficient: Not enough data to take a view.

live.supply_pressure: For living in, this is actually an opportunity: more choice and room to negotiate on price.
live.mature: Established amenities and easy resale — good to live in.
live.future: Amenities may not be built out yet; check day-to-day convenience before committing.
live.growth: Living experience depends on the specific project and its amenities.
live.stable: Living experience depends on the specific project and its amenities.
live.insufficient: Not enough data to take a view.

classification.methodology: Tiers are derived from DLD sales: transaction volume and year-on-year price growth are ranked against citywide quantiles (top/bottom third) rather than arbitrary absolute cut-offs. Data is a periodic snapshot, not real time. Labels are indicative only and are not investment advice.
